; Canonical application identities use the shared cons and intern relations.
(<- (Partial ?Source ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments)
    (intern Partial ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Partial ?Source ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Partial ?Arguments ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments))

(<- (Option ?Source ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments)
    (intern Option ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Option ?Source ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Option ?Arguments ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments))

(<- (Key ?Name ?Options ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Options ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Name ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern Key ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Key ?Name ?Options ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Key ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Name ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Options ?Empty ?TailArguments))

(<- (Pick ?Source ?Names ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Names ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern Pick ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Pick ?Source ?Names ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Pick ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Names ?Empty ?TailArguments))

(<- (Exclude ?Source ?Names ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Names ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern Exclude ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Exclude ?Source ?Names ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Exclude ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Names ?Empty ?TailArguments))

; HistoryV1 options are ordinary typed data. The first version accepts copy
; mode plus a source contract and interns source plus options as the
; specialization identity.
(<- (HistoryV1 ?Source ?Options ?Result)
    (edge_snapshot ?Options ?Mode "copy" 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Options ?ContractName ?Contract 1)
    (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Options ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern HistoryV1 ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (HistoryV1 ?Source ?Options ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot HistoryV1 ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Options ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (edge_snapshot ?Options ?Mode "copy" 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Options ?ContractName ?Contract 1)
    (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?Proof))
